capabilities: Add jump-to-top and jump-to-bottom buttons to the Outline pane toolbar
Scroll the note to its first or last line
Keep scrolling through lazily rendered reading view until the end
Follow the pane the outline is showing when split panes are open
Close the mobile outline drawer after jumping
extras: Requires the core Outline plugin to be enabled; only scrolls and never moves the cursor or changes the note.
intentEvidence: The core Outline pane lets you jump to any heading, but not to the very top or the very bottom of the note.
problem: The core Outline pane can jump to any heading but not to the very top or bottom of a note, forcing manual scrolling on long notes.
summary: Adds jump-to-top and jump-to-bottom buttons to the core Outline pane for scrolling long notes.
